cards.name: DataContext
cards.summary: Corel UI-framework data context (ICUIDataContext, also in CrlFrmWkOM): the object that binds docker / dialog UI to named data sources. A script can list its categories, look up or add a data source, open a framework dialog by GUID, or spawn a temporary child context. It has nothing to do with object data on shapes (that is DataField / DataItem).
use_for: wire a custom add-in docker to a data source object written in VBA or C#
open a framework dialog by its GUID from an add-in
inspect which data categories the running workspace exposes
avoid: storing per-shape metadata: use Document.DataFields and Shape.ObjectData (DataField / DataItem)
ordinary drawing macros: nothing in the VGCore drawing model needs it
cards.how: Members live on ICUIDataContext. Reach it through the framework, not through a document: Application.FrameWork (ICUIFrameWork) -> .Application (ICUIApplication) -> .DataContext. AddDataSource registers an object under a name in this context and returns its DataSourceProxy; GetDataSource returns the proxy for an existing name; CreateChildDataContext makes a temporary child scoped to a category list.

key_members.name: Categories
key_members.use: comma-separated list of the categories this context implements

key_members.name: HasCategory
key_members.use: True when a category is supported; test before relying on one

key_members.name: GetDataSource
key_members.use: proxy (DataSourceProxy) for a data source by name

key_members.name: AddDataSource
key_members.use: add an object as a named data source; returns its DataSourceProxy

key_members.name: CreateChildDataContext
key_members.use: temporary child context, optionally limited to a category list

key_members.name: ShowDialog
key_members.use: show a framework dialog by its GUID string; returns a bool

gotchas: It comes from the framework type library (also_in CrlFrmWkOM), so the VGCore object model (Application.ActiveDocument ...) never returns it; go through Application.FrameWork.Application.

Data source names and category strings are defined by the workspace / add-in XML, not by the type library; a wrong name is not listed anywhere in the harvest (unverified what GetDataSource returns for an unknown name: Nothing or an error).
ShowDialog wants a dialog GUID from the workspace definition, not a caption (unverified which GUIDs are valid in 25.1).
cards.example:
Dim ctx As Object, ds As Object
Set ctx = Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext
Debug.Print ctx.Categories
Set ds = ctx.GetDataSource("MyAddonData")   ' name your add-in registered
If Not ds Is Nothing Then Debug.Print ds.Name
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DataField
cards.summary: Definition of one object-data field of a document (a column of the Object Data Manager): its name, data type, display format, default value, constraint and width. The values for each shape are DataItem objects that point back to this field.
use_for: tag every shape of a catalogue or signage layout with SKU, price or room number
define a field once and pre-fill a default so new shapes carry it
drive a data-merge or a parts-list export from per-object metadata
avoid: text that must print: object data is invisible metadata; put printed values in a text shape
adding values: a DataField is the column, write values with Shape.ObjectData(<field>).Value
cards.how: Members live on IVGDataField. Fields belong to the document: ActiveDocument.DataFields("Name") or .Item(index) returns a DataField; DataFields.Add / AddEx / AddEx2 create one. Each shape's value for the field is Shape.ObjectData("Name") (a DataItem).

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: get / set the field name (the key used by ObjectData("..."))

key_members.name: Format
key_members.use: display format string applied to values

key_members.name: FormatType
key_members.use: read-only cdrDataFormatType: general, date/time, linear/angular, numeric

key_members.name: DefaultValue
key_members.use: value a shape shows until it is given its own

key_members.name: FieldWidth
key_members.use: column width in the Object Data Manager

key_members.name: AppDefault
key_members.use: field is added to every new document

key_members.name: DocDefault
key_members.use: field is a default of this document

key_members.name: SummarizeGroup
key_members.use: summarise the values of a group's children

key_members.name: Reorder
key_members.use: move the field to a new index

key_members.name: Target
key_members.use: target filter the data is designated for

key_members.name: ParentName
key_members.use: parent name used by AddEx2-style structured fields

key_members.name: ElementName
key_members.use: element name used by AddEx2-style structured fields

gotchas: Delete removes the column, so every shape loses its value for it; there is no per-shape delete here (use DataItem.Clear).
FormatType is read-only: it follows from the Format / data type you set (unverified exact mapping).
AppDefault = True makes the field appear in all future documents, which is easy to leave on by accident in a test macro.
New documents already contain some default fields (Name, Cost, Comments are believed to be there) so check DataFields.IsPresent before Add (unverified list).
cards.example:
Dim f As DataField
If ActiveDocument.DataFields.IsPresent("SKU") Then
    Set f = ActiveDocument.DataFields("SKU")
Else
    Set f = ActiveDocument.DataFields.Add("SKU")
End If
f.DefaultValue = "TBD"
ActiveShape.ObjectData("SKU").Value = "A-1001"
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DataFields
cards.summary: Collection of all object-data field definitions of one document (the columns of the Object Data Manager). Used to look up, test for, and add fields before writing per-shape values.
use_for: make sure a SKU / price / status field exists before a tagging macro runs
list the metadata columns of a client file before exporting a parts list
add typed fields (number, string) with defaults for a data-driven layout
avoid: reading a shape's values: use Shape.ObjectData (DataItems), this collection holds only the definitions
cards.how: Members live on IVGDataFields. Reach it with ActiveDocument.DataFields (IVGDocument.DataFields). Item takes an index (base 1) or a name and is the default member, so DataFields("SKU") works in VBA. Add takes name plus optional format and default flags; AddEx adds data type, default value, constraint, target and width; AddEx2 also takes a parent and element name.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: field by base-1 index or by name

key_members.name: IsPresent
key_members.use: True when a field with that name exists; check before Add

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: add a field: Name, optional Format, AppDefault, DocDefault, SummarizeGroup

key_members.name: AddEx
key_members.use: add a field with DataType, DefaultValue, Constraint, Target, Format and FieldWidth

key_members.name: AddEx2
key_members.use: like AddEx with a ParentName and ElementName first

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the fields

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the Document that owns the fields

gotchas: Item is base 1, not base 0.
Adding a name that already exists is expected to fail; guard with IsPresent (unverified whether it errors or returns the existing field).
There is no Remove on the collection: delete a field through DataField.Delete.
cards.example:
Dim f As DataField
For Each f In ActiveDocument.DataFields
    Debug.Print f.Index, f.Name, f.DataType
Next f
If Not ActiveDocument.DataFields.IsPresent("Price") Then
    ActiveDocument.DataFields.AddEx "Price", cdrDataTypeNumber, "0"
End If
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DataItem
cards.summary: One shape's value for one object-data field (a cell of the Object Data Manager). Holds the raw Value, the value formatted with the field's format, and a link to its DataField.
use_for: write a SKU, price or status onto a shape from a spreadsheet import
read back per-object metadata to build a bill of materials or a price list
clear stale values before handing a template to a client
avoid: deleting the field for every shape: that is DataField.Delete; Clear only empties this shape's value
cards.how: Members live on IVGDataItem. Reach it from a shape: Shape.ObjectData("FieldName") or Shape.ObjectData(index) (IVGShape.ObjectData returns DataItems). Value is a Variant you can read and write; FormattedValue is read-only text.

key_members.name: FormattedValue
key_members.use: the value as text, formatted with the field's Format

key_members.name: DataField
key_members.use: the DataField this value belongs to (name, type, format)

key_members.name: Clear
key_members.use: empty this shape's value for the field

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the DataItems collection of the shape

gotchas: Value is a Variant: a number field may hand back a string after a round trip through the UI; convert explicitly (unverified).
On a shape that was never given a value the item reports the field default (unverified).
Values on a group and on its children are separate; SummarizeGroup on the field controls how the group summarises (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActivePage.Shapes
    If s.ObjectData("SKU").Value <> "" Then
        Debug.Print s.Name, s.ObjectData("SKU").FormattedValue
    End If
Next s
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DataItems
cards.summary: Collection of all object-data values attached to one shape (one row of the Object Data Manager). Used to read every field of a shape, add a value for a field, copy a whole row from another shape, or clear it.
use_for: copy SKU / price metadata from a master shape to its duplicates
dump every metadata field of selected objects for a parts list
wipe metadata before exporting a client file
avoid: defining new fields: that is ActiveDocument.DataFields.Add; this collection only holds values
cards.how: Members live on IVGDataItems. Reach it with Shape.ObjectData (IVGShape.ObjectData). Item takes a base-1 index or a field name and is the default member: s.ObjectData("SKU").Value. Add attaches a value for an existing DataField; CopyFrom copies all items from another shape.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: value object (DataItem) by base-1 index or field name

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of data items on the shape

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: add a value for a DataField, with optional Value

key_members.name: CopyFrom
key_members.use: copy all data items from another shape

key_members.name: Clear
key_members.use: clear every data item of the shape

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the items

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the Shape the data belongs to

gotchas: Item is base 1.
Add needs a DataField object, not a field name; get it from ActiveDocument.DataFields first.
Clear empties the whole row for this shape, not just one field (use DataItem.Clear for one).
cards.example:
Dim src As Shape, s As Shape
Set src = ActiveSelectionRange(1)
For Each s In ActiveSelectionRange
    If Not s Is src Then s.ObjectData.CopyFrom src
Next s
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DataSourceProxy
cards.summary: Corel UI-framework handle on a named data source (ICUIDataSourceProxy, also in CrlFrmWkOM): lets a script read and write the source's properties by name, invoke one of its methods, and tell bound UI listeners to refresh.
use_for: push a new value into an add-in docker's data source and refresh the controls bound to it
trigger a command method of a framework data source from a macro
avoid: per-shape metadata (use DataField / DataItem)
plain drawing macros that have no custom UI
cards.how: Members live on ICUIDataSourceProxy. Obtained from a DataContext: Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource("Name"), or returned by DataContext.AddDataSource when you register your own object. Properties and methods are addressed by string name, so there is no compile-time checking.

key_members.name: GetProperty
key_members.use: read a data-source property by name (Variant)

key_members.name: SetProperty
key_members.use: write a data-source property by name

key_members.name: InvokeMethod
key_members.use: call a handler on the data source by name

key_members.name: UpdateListeners
key_members.use: refresh the UI listeners named in a comma-separated list

gotchas: Property and method names are strings defined by whoever wrote the data source; a typo is only caught at run time.
After SetProperty the bound UI may not redraw until UpdateListeners is called with the listener names (unverified).
Framework objects live in CrlFrmWkOM; they are not reachable from Document or Shape.
cards.example:
Dim ds As Object
Set ds = Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource("MyAddonData")
ds.SetProperty "Status", "ready"
ds.UpdateListeners "Status"
Debug.Print ds.GetProperty("Status")
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: Dimension
cards.summary: Settings of a dimension (measurement) object: label precision, prefix / suffix, units, boxed or centred text, placement, dynamic updating, extension-line visibility and the custom gaps and overhangs. Linear and angular specifics hang off it as DimensionLinear / DimensionAngular.
use_for: label packaging dielines and technical drawings with live measurements
restyle every dimension in a file (precision, unit suffix, boxed text) in one macro
build signage or furniture spec sheets with consistent callouts
avoid: static annotation text: a dimension is tied to snap points and updates when they move; use a text shape for fixed notes
changing geometry: move the anchor points (Linear.Point1 / Point2) rather than the label
cards.how: Members live on IVGDimension. Create dimension shapes with ActiveLayer.CreateLinearDimension(Type, Point1, Point2, ...) or ActiveLayer.CreateAngularDimension(Center, Point1, Point2, TextX, TextY, ...), both taking SnapPoint anchors; read the settings of an existing one with Shape.Dimension. Type says which sub-object (Linear or Angular) is valid.

key_members.name: Precision
key_members.use: digits after the decimal point in the label

key_members.name: ShowUnits
key_members.use: append the unit to the label

key_members.name: BoxedText
key_members.use: draw a rectangle around the label

key_members.name: TextCentered
key_members.use: centre the label on the dimension line

key_members.name: HorizontalText
key_members.use: keep the label horizontal on slanted dimensions

key_members.name: DynamicText
key_members.use: update the label automatically when the measured shapes change

key_members.name: TextShape
key_members.use: the label as a text shape (font, size, colour)

key_members.name: Outline
key_members.use: outline of the dimension lines (width, colour, arrows)

key_members.name: SetDistanceFromObject
key_members.use: set a custom distance of the dimension line from the object

key_members.name: SetTextLabelGap
key_members.use: set the gap around the label

gotchas: DistanceFromObject, Overhang and TextLabelGap are read-only in the harvest; change them with SetDistanceFromObject / SetOverhang / SetTextLabelGap, and the matching Use... flag says whether the custom value is in force.
cdrShapeType has only cdrLinearDimensionShape in the harvest; test Shape.Dimension.Type to tell linear from angular (unverified that angular dimensions report the same shape type).
Turning DynamicText off freezes the label at its current value; resizing the measured object afterwards leaves a wrong number.

The number in the label is in the Units of the Linear / Angular object (cdrDimensionLinearUnits / cdrDimensionAngularUnits), not in Document.Unit (which only sets script coordinates); a typed Suffix does not convert it.
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActivePage.Shapes
    If s.Type = cdrLinearDimensionShape Then
        s.Dimension.Precision = 1
        s.Dimension.BoxedText = True
    End If
Next s
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: unit gotcha said the label follows Document.Unit, contradicting DimensionLinear (label uses the Units property)

cards.name: DimensionAngular
cards.summary: Angular-dimension settings: the centre and the two arc points (snap points), label position, unit (degrees, radians, gradians, degree symbol), measuring direction and inner extension lines.
use_for: mark angles on technical illustrations, packaging folds or architectural details
switch every angle callout in a drawing to the degree symbol or to radians
avoid: straight-line measurements: use Dimension.Linear (DimensionLinear)
cards.how: Members live on IVGDimensionAngular. Reach it from a dimension shape: Shape.Dimension.Angular (valid when Shape.Dimension.Type = cdrDimensionAngular). Create one with ActiveLayer.CreateAngularDimension(Center, Point1, Point2, TextX, TextY, Precision, ShowUnits, Units, ...).

key_members.name: Center
key_members.use: snap point at the vertex of the angle

key_members.name: Point1
key_members.use: snap point on the first arm

key_members.name: Point2
key_members.use: snap point on the second arm

key_members.name: ShowUnits
key_members.use: append the unit to the label

key_members.name: Clockwise
key_members.use: measure the angle clockwise instead of counter-clockwise

gotchas: Point properties are SnapPoint objects tied to shapes; moving the shapes moves the dimension, so do not expect fixed coordinates.
Clockwise flips which of the two possible arcs is measured, so the label can change from A to 360 - A (unverified exact rule).
Accessing Shape.Dimension.Angular on a linear dimension is expected to fail; check Dimension.Type first (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim a As Object
Set a = ActiveShape.Dimension.Angular
a.Units = cdrDimensionUnitDegreesSymbol
a.ShowUnits = True
Debug.Print a.TextX, a.TextY
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DimensionLinear
cards.summary: Linear-dimension settings: horizontal, vertical or slanted type, the two anchor snap points, label position and number style (decimal, fractional, engineering, architectural), unit, placement and the dimension-arrow (terminator) behaviour.
use_for: dimension dielines, panels and product drawings in mm or inches
convert every linear callout to architectural feet-inches or to millimetres
flip arrows outside the witness lines on short dimensions
avoid: angle callouts: use Dimension.Angular
cards.how: Members live on IVGDimensionLinear. Reach it with Shape.Dimension.Linear (when Dimension.Type = cdrDimensionLinear). Create with ActiveLayer.CreateLinearDimension(Type, Point1, Point2, TextCentered, TextX, TextY, Style, Precision, ShowUnits, Units, Placement, ...), where Type is cdrDimensionHorizontal, cdrDimensionVertical or cdrDimensionSlanted.

key_members.name: Style
key_members.use: number style: cdrDimensionStyleDecimal / Fractional / Engineering / Architectural

key_members.name: ShowUnits
key_members.use: append the unit to the label

key_members.name: TextCentered
key_members.use: centre the label between the anchors

key_members.name: Placement
key_members.use: label above, within or below the dimension line

key_members.name: HorizontalText
key_members.use: keep the label horizontal on a slanted dimension

key_members.name: ReverseTerminators
key_members.use: put the arrows outside the extension lines

key_members.name: AutoReverseTerminators
key_members.use: reverse arrows automatically when there is no room

key_members.name: SetReverseTerminatorLength
key_members.use: set the length of reversed arrow ends

key_members.name: InnerDimensionLineVisible
key_members.use: show the line between the extension lines when arrows are reversed

gotchas: Units here is the label unit (cdrDimensionLinearUnits, default cdrDimensionUnitMM = 15 in CreateLinearDimension); it is separate from Document.Unit used for coordinates.

Several unit constants look alike (cdrDimensionUnitMM vs cdrDimensionUnitMillimeters, cdrDimensionUnitIN vs cdrDimensionUnitInches): they differ in the label text, abbreviated or spelled out (unverified).
ReverseTerminatorLength is read-only; set it with SetReverseTerminatorLength.
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape, L As Object
Set s = ActiveLayer.CreateLinearDimension(cdrDimensionHorizontal, _
    ActiveShape.SnapPoints.BBox(cdrTopLeft), ActiveShape.SnapPoints.BBox(cdrTopRight))
Set L = s.Dimension.Linear
L.Units = cdrDimensionUnitMM
L.Style = cdrDimensionStyleDecimal

cards.name: DIVGApplicationEvents
cards.summary: Application-level event interface (hidden dispinterface): the callbacks CorelDRAW fires for document open / new / close, before and after save, print and export, window activation, selection change, start, quit, plug-in commands and generic application events. The Query... events let a handler veto the action by setting Cancel.
use_for: preflight a file before every save or export (block it when linked images are missing)
log every export path for an asset-tracking or delivery checklist
auto-apply house settings when any document is opened or created
drive the enabled / checked state of a custom plug-in command
avoid: events that belong to one document only: use DIVGDocumentEvents
heavy work in SelectionChange: it fires on every click
cards.how: Not created by scripts: it is the event (source) interface of the Application object. In VBA write handlers in the GlobalMacros project's ThisMacroStorage module, named GlobalMacroStorage_<Event>; an external COM client connects with Application.AdviseEvents(sink) and disconnects with UnadviseEvents(cookie); Python can use win32com.client.DispatchWithEvents("CorelDRAW.Application.25", Handler) with On<Event> methods. Application.EventsEnabled switches event delivery.

key_members.name: QueryDocumentSave
key_members.use: before a save; set Cancel = True to block it

key_members.name: QueryDocumentExport
key_members.use: before an export; Cancel blocks it

key_members.name: QueryDocumentClose
key_members.use: before a close; Cancel keeps the document open

key_members.name: QueryQuit
key_members.use: before the application quits; Cancel keeps it running

key_members.name: DocumentNew
key_members.use: a document was created (template info included)

key_members.name: OnPluginCommand
key_members.use: a command added with Application.AddPluginCommand was run

key_members.name: OnUpdatePluginCommand
key_members.use: set Enabled / Checked for a plug-in command

key_members.name: OnApplicationEvent
key_members.use: generic named event with a parameter array

gotchas: Typelib flags mark it hidden: object browsers do not list it, but the events still fire.
Cancel is passed ByRef; declare it without ByVal or setting it has no effect.
Application.EventsEnabled = False (often set by batch macros for speed) silences every handler until it is set back.
A handler that edits the document can trigger further events (SelectionChange, document ShapeChange); guard against re-entry.
The ThisMacroStorage / GlobalMacroStorage_ naming is the VBA convention (unverified for 25.1 workspaces without GlobalMacros.gms).
cards.example:
' GlobalMacros > ThisMacroStorage
Private Sub GlobalMacroStorage_QueryDocumentExport(ByVal Doc As Document, Cancel As Boolean)
    If Doc.ActivePage.Shapes.Count = 0 Then Cancel = True
End Sub
Private Sub GlobalMacroStorage_DocumentAfterExport(ByVal Doc As Document, ByVal FileName As String, ByVal Filter As cdrFilter, ByVal SaveBitmap As Boolean)
    Debug.Print "exported " & FileName
End Sub
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DIVGDocumentEvents
cards.summary: Per-document event interface (hidden dispinterface): callbacks for one document's open, close, save, print and export (with Query... vetoes), and for layers, pages and shapes being created, deleted, moved, transformed, distorted or changed, plus selection change.
use_for: keep a live parts list or price total in sync as shapes are added or deleted
re-run a layout rule when a template's key shape is moved or changed
block saving a template until required fields are filled
avoid: watching every document at once: use DIVGApplicationEvents
reacting to the deleted shape itself: delete events only report a count
cards.how: The event (source) interface of the Document coclass. In VBA, handlers go in a document's ThisDocument module as Document_<Event>; a COM client connects with Document.AdviseEvents(sink) and Document.UnadviseEvents(cookie); Python can use win32com.client.WithEvents(doc, Handler) with On<Event> methods.

key_members.name: QuerySave
key_members.use: before a save; set Cancel = True to block it

key_members.name: QueryClose
key_members.use: before the document closes; Cancel keeps it open

key_members.name: ShapeTransform
key_members.use: a shape was scaled, rotated or skewed

key_members.name: ShapeChange
key_members.use: a shape changed; Scope is a cdrShapeChangeScope bit mask

key_members.name: SelectionChange
key_members.use: the selection in this document changed

gotchas: ShapeChange Scope is a bit mask (cdrShapeChangeFill = 1, Outline = 2, Transparency = 4, Content = 8 ...); test bits with And, not equality.
ShapeDelete, LayerDelete and PageDelete pass only a Count: the objects are already gone.
Handlers that modify shapes raise more Shape... events; set Application.EventsEnabled = False while the handler edits and restore it after.
Hidden in the type library, so it does not appear in the object browser; handler names must match exactly.
cards.example:
' ThisDocument module of the document's VBA project
Private Sub Document_ShapeChange(ByVal Shape As Shape, ByVal Scope As cdrShapeChangeScope)
    If (Scope And cdrShapeChangeFill) <> 0 Then Debug.Print "fill changed: " & Shape.Name
End Sub
Private Sub Document_QuerySave(Cancel As Boolean)
    If ActiveDocument.DataFields.Count = 0 Then Cancel = True
End Sub
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DockHost
cards.summary: Corel UI-framework dock host (ICUIDockHost, also in CrlFrmWkOM): a horizontal or vertical docking area of a frame window that holds dock items (nested dock hosts or view hosts such as dockers and document views). Scripts use it to inspect or rearrange the window layout.
use_for: inspect where dockers are docked in the current workspace
insert a custom view or view host into a docking area from an add-in
avoid: showing or hiding a docker by GUID: ICUIFrameWork.ShowDocker / HideDocker is simpler
anything in the drawing itself
cards.how: Members live on ICUIDockHost. Reach it from a frame window: Application.FrameWork.MainFrameWindow.RootDockHost, or .DockHosts (DockHosts collection). Children returns the DockItems inside it; each DockItem is either another dock host or a view host.

key_members.name: Children
key_members.use: the DockItems directly inside this host

key_members.name: ParentDockHost
key_members.use: the dock host that contains this one

key_members.name: DockItem
key_members.use: this host seen as a DockItem of its parent

key_members.name: InsertViewHost
key_members.use: insert an existing view host at an index

key_members.name: InsertView
key_members.use: wrap a view window in a new view host and insert it

gotchas: Framework objects come from CrlFrmWkOM, not from Document; nothing here changes the artwork.
Layout changes go into the user's workspace and can persist after restart (unverified).

The optional Operation argument of InsertView / InsertViewHost is a cuiDockOperation: cuiDockOperationInsert (0), cuiDockOperationSplitTopLeft (1) or cuiDockOperationSplitBottomRight (2); the exact split behaviour is unverified.
cards.example:
Dim h As Object, it As Object
Set h = Application.FrameWork.MainFrameWindow.RootDockHost
Debug.Print h.ID, h.Orientation
For Each it In h.Children
    Debug.Print it.ID, it.Type, it.RelativeSize
Next it
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: cuiDockOperation values are in the harvest; gotcha lists them instead of calling them unknown

cards.name: DockHosts
cards.summary: Corel UI-framework collection of the dock hosts of a frame window (ICUIDockHosts, also in CrlFrmWkOM), with lookup by ID and first / last access.
use_for: walk all docking areas of the main window to find where an add-in docker sits
find a dock host by ID before inserting a view into it
avoid: toggling dockers: use ICUIFrameWork.ShowDocker / HideDocker
cards.how: Members live on ICUIDockHosts. Reach it with Application.FrameWork.MainFrameWindow.DockHosts (ICUIFrameWindow.DockHosts).

key_members.name: Find
key_members.use: dock host by its ID string

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the hosts

gotchas: Index base for Item is not stated in the harvest (unverified; most Corel collections are base 1).
IDs are workspace-specific; one saved in one workspace may not exist in another.
cards.example:
Dim h As Object
For Each h In Application.FrameWork.MainFrameWindow.DockHosts
    Debug.Print h.ID, h.Orientation, h.Children.Count
Next h
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DockItem
cards.summary: Corel UI-framework dock item (ICUIDockItem, also in CrlFrmWkOM): one entry inside a dock host, which is either a nested dock host or a view host (a docker or view). Gives its type, index, relative size and screen position.
use_for: resize a docked panel relative to its neighbours from an add-in
tell docked view hosts from nested docking areas while walking the layout
avoid: drawing work of any kind
cards.how: Members live on ICUIDockItem. Get items from DockHost.Children (DockItems) or from DockHost.DockItem / ViewHost.DockItem. Type is cuiDockItemDockHost or cuiDockItemViewHost and tells which of DockHost / ViewHost is valid.

key_members.name: DockHost
key_members.use: the dock host, when Type is cuiDockItemDockHost

key_members.name: ViewHost
key_members.use: the view host, when Type is cuiDockItemViewHost

key_members.name: Index
key_members.use: position in the parent dock host

key_members.name: RelativeSize
key_members.use: size relative to the other items of the parent (settable)

gotchas: Only one of DockHost / ViewHost is meaningful for a given Type (unverified whether the other returns Nothing or errors).
RelativeSize is a proportion among siblings, not pixels.
cards.example:
Dim it As Object
For Each it In Application.FrameWork.MainFrameWindow.RootDockHost.Children
    If it.Type = cuiDockItemViewHost Then Debug.Print it.ID, it.RelativeSize
Next it
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DockItems
cards.summary: Corel UI-framework collection of the dock items inside one dock host (ICUIDockItems, also in CrlFrmWkOM), with lookup by ID and first / last access.
use_for: walk the dockers and nested areas inside one docking area
find a docked item by ID before resizing it
avoid: drawing work of any kind
cards.how: Members live on ICUIDockItems. Reach it with DockHost.Children, e.g. Application.FrameWork.MainFrameWindow.RootDockHost.Children.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of items in the dock host

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the items

gotchas: Index base for Item is not stated in the harvest (unverified).
The collection reflects the layout at the moment you read it; re-read after docking changes.
cards.example:
Dim items As Object
Set items = Application.FrameWork.MainFrameWindow.RootDockHost.Children
Debug.Print items.Count, items.First.ID, items.Last.ID
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: Document
cards.summary: A CorelDRAW (or Corel DESIGNER) document: pages, layers, selection, units and drawing origin, undo grouping, save / export / PDF publishing, object-data fields, styles, colour context and the document palette. It is the root object for almost every scripted design job.
use_for: batch-export every page of a brochure to PDF or PNG
build a print-ready layout: add pages at a set size, set units, place artwork
wrap a multi-step macro in one undo step
preflight a client file: units, resolution, linked bitmaps, colour context
avoid: looping over open files: use Application.Documents, and open / create files with Application.OpenDocument / CreateDocument (Documents has no Add or Open)
cards.how: Members live on IVGDocument. Reach it with ActiveDocument (Application.ActiveDocument), Documents(i), or the return value of Application.CreateDocument / OpenDocument. Pages, ActivePage, ActiveLayer and SelectionRange lead to the artwork; Unit, ReferencePoint and DrawingOriginX/Y set how every coordinate the script passes is read.

key_members.name: ActiveLayer
key_members.use: the layer new shapes go on

key_members.name: AddPagesEx
key_members.use: append pages of a given width and height

key_members.name: Unit
key_members.use: unit for every position and size the script passes (cdrUnit)

key_members.name: ReferencePoint
key_members.use: which point of a shape positions refer to

key_members.name: SaveSettings
key_members.use: remember Unit, origin and similar settings

key_members.name: RestoreSettings
key_members.use: put them back at the end of a macro

key_members.name: SelectionRange
key_members.use: the selected shapes as a ShapeRange

key_members.name: SaveAs
key_members.use: save to a new path with SaveAs options

key_members.name: Export
key_members.use: export to a non-native format via a cdrFilter

key_members.name: ExportBitmap
key_members.use: export to a raster format with size, resolution and anti-aliasing

gotchas: Unit is the scripting unit and is separate from the ruler units the user sees (Rulers.HUnits / VUnits); scripts usually find it at inches (unverified for every document), so set it at the start of every macro (SaveSettings / RestoreSettings keep the previous value).
CorelDRAW coordinates grow upward on Y from the drawing origin (page lower-left by default, DrawingOriginX / Y), unlike Photoshop's top-down pixel coordinates.
Selection returns a special selection shape (cdrSelectionShape) that changes as the selection changes; take a ShapeRange with SelectionRange when you need a stable list.
Without BeginCommandGroup / EndCommandGroup every call is a separate undo step; an error between them leaves the group open, so end it in the error handler.
Close does not ask about unsaved changes when called from a script (unverified); check Dirty and Save first if needed.
Resolution / ResolutionX / ResolutionY are the document pixel resolution (DPI); pass ResolutionX / ResolutionY to ExportBitmap explicitly rather than relying on what it defaults to (unverified).

SaveAs(path) alone fails (Python: "The Python instance can not be converted to a COM object"): pass an options object, o = app.CreateStructSaveAsOptions(); o.Overwrite = True; doc.SaveAs(path, o). The document is renamed to the saved file (plan runs 2026-10-15 (print_prep.package_for_print)).

PublishToPDF exports every page of the document, including a hidden masters page that a scene may carry (the PDF had 2 pages): set doc.PDFSettings.PublishRange = 1 to publish the current page only (plan runs 2026-10-15 (print_prep.pdfx_export)).
cards.example:
Dim doc As Document
Set doc = ActiveDocument
doc.SaveSettings
doc.Unit = cdrMillimeter
doc.BeginCommandGroup "Add badge"
ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2 105, 148, 30
doc.EndCommandGroup
doc.RestoreSettings
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: gotcha claimed Unit defaults to the ruler unit (unsupported; scripting unit is separate from ruler units, inches in harvest tests); dropped the claim that Illustrator scripting is Y-down (its scripting Y also grows upward); removed unsupported claim that ExportBitmap / effect defaults follow Document.Resolution

cards.name: Documents
cards.summary: Collection of all open documents, in the order they were created or opened. Read-only access by index, count and enumeration; documents are opened and created through Application, not here.
use_for: batch-export or preflight every open file
find an already-open document by file name before opening it again
avoid: opening or creating files: use Application.OpenDocument / CreateDocument / CreateDocumentFromTemplate; this collection has no Add or Open
cards.how: Members live on IVGDocuments. Reach it with Documents (Application.Documents). Item takes a base-1 index; iterate with For Each.

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the documents

gotchas: Item takes only an index (long) in the harvest, not a name; match Document.FileName or Title yourself.
Closing documents inside a For Each over this collection changes it under the loop; walk it backwards by index instead.
Temporary documents made by Document.Clone have no window (IsTemporary) and may or may not be listed (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim i As Long, d As Document
For i = Documents.Count To 1 Step -1
    Set d = Documents(i)
    Debug.Print d.Title, d.FullFileName, d.Dirty
Next i
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: Duotone
cards.summary: Duotone settings for a bitmap: monotone, duotone, tritone or quadtone, the inks with their tone curves, and the optional overprint colour overrides; can be loaded from or saved to a .cpd preset file.
use_for: give photos a two-colour spot-ink look for a two-colour print job
apply a brand-colour monotone to every photo in a brochure
save a duotone recipe as .cpd and reuse it across jobs
avoid: a quick colour tint on screen-only work: a transparency or lens is easier and stays vector-editable
vector shapes: duotone applies to bitmaps only (Shape.Bitmap)
cards.how: Members live on IVGDuotone. Create a fresh one with Application.CreateDuotone(), read the settings of a duotone bitmap with Shape.Bitmap.Duotone, and apply with Shape.Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone(dt). Inks(i) returns each DuotoneInk; Overprints(i) the DuotoneOverprint combinations when UseOverprints is True.

key_members.name: Inks
key_members.use: one ink (colour plus tone curve) by index

gotchas: Type is read / write in the type library (not read-only, although its description says 'Returns'); what setting it does to the existing inks is unverified, so loading a .cpd is the safer way to get a given ink count.
Ink colours must be valid duotone colours; IVGColor.IsValidDuotoneColor / ValidDuotoneColor exist to check and fix them.
The index base of Inks and Overprints is not stated in the harvest (unverified).
Bitmap.Duotone on a bitmap that is not in duotone mode (Bitmap.Mode <> cdrDuotoneImage) is not meaningful (unverified whether it errors).
cards.example:
Dim dt As Duotone
Set dt = CreateDuotone()
If dt.Load("C:\presets\warm_duotone.cpd") Then
    ActiveShape.Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone dt
End If
Debug.Print ActiveShape.Bitmap.Duotone.InkCount
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: Type is not read-only in the harvest; gotcha now says so

cards.name: DuotoneInk
cards.summary: One ink of a duotone: its colour and its tone-transfer curve (handles that map bitmap grey levels to ink coverage, 256 levels), with load / save of .cik ink files.
use_for: shape how much of a spot colour prints in highlights versus shadows
store a tuned ink curve as .cik and reuse it in other duotones
avoid: global brightness or contrast changes to the photo: adjust the bitmap first, keep ink curves for ink distribution
cards.how: Members live on IVGDuotoneInk. Reach it with Duotone.Inks(index) from Application.CreateDuotone() or Shape.Bitmap.Duotone. Handles are integer x / y pairs on the curve; GetCurveLevels returns the resulting 256-entry curve.

key_members.name: HandleX
key_members.use: x of a handle by index

key_members.name: HandleY
key_members.use: y of a handle by index

key_members.name: AddHandle
key_members.use: add a handle at x, y; returns its index

key_members.name: FindHandle
key_members.use: index of the handle at x, y

key_members.name: GetHandles
key_members.use: all handle positions as an array

key_members.name: PutHandles
key_members.use: set all handle positions from an array

key_members.name: CurveLevel
key_members.use: curve level at one input value

key_members.name: Load
key_members.use: load ink settings from a .cik file

key_members.name: Save
key_members.use: save ink settings to a .cik file

gotchas: Handle coordinates are integers; with 256 curve levels the useful range is most likely 0 to 255 on both axes (unverified).
Whether the IVGColor returned by Color is live (editing it changes the ink) or a copy is unverified; assigning a new colour is the safer route.
Changes to an ink only reach the bitmap when the Duotone is applied again with Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim dt As Duotone, ink As Object
Set dt = ActiveShape.Bitmap.Duotone
Set ink = dt.Inks(1)
ink.Reset
ink.AddHandle 128, 90
ActiveShape.Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone dt
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: DuotoneOverprint
cards.summary: One overprint ink combination of a duotone (where two or more inks overlap): CMYK components and a colour override that set the colour shown where those inks overlap.
use_for: make the on-screen and composite proof of overlapping spot inks match a printed swatch
reset overlap colours after changing duotone inks
avoid: changing the inks themselves: use DuotoneInk.Color and the tone curve
cards.how: Members live on IVGDuotoneOverprint. Reach it with Duotone.Overprints(index) (OverprintCount gives the number of combinations); the overrides apply when Duotone.UseOverprints is True.

key_members.name: SetValues
key_members.use: set Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black in one call

key_members.name: Cyan
key_members.use: cyan component of the overlap colour

gotchas: Overrides do nothing unless Duotone.UseOverprints is True.
Overprint colours are believed to affect the composite / screen rendering, not the separated ink plates (unverified for CorelDRAW 25.1).
Component range is not stated in the harvest; 0 to 100 percent is the usual CorelDRAW CMYK range (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim dt As Duotone
Set dt = ActiveShape.Bitmap.Duotone
dt.UseOverprints = True
dt.Overprints(1).SetValues 0, 40, 100, 20
ActiveShape.Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone dt
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: summary no longer asserts the unverified 'composite preview only' behaviour

cards.name: EdgeSnapPoint
cards.summary: Extra data of a snap point that sits on a path edge rather than on a node: which segment it is on and where along that segment (a parametric time value).
use_for: anchor a dimension or connector to a point partway along a curve
read where an edge snap point lies on a path
avoid: node positions: use the Curve / Node objects; bounding-box corners: use SnapPoints.BBox
cards.how: Members live on IVGEdgeSnapPoint. Reach it with SnapPoint.Edge on a snap point whose Type is cdrSnapPointEdge; Shape.SnapPoints.Edge(SegmentIndex, SegmentOffset) returns such a SnapPoint for a chosen segment and offset.

key_members.name: SegmentIndex
key_members.use: index of the path segment the point is on

gotchas: SegmentOffset is a curve parameter, not a distance: 0.5 is the middle of a straight segment but not, in general, the arc-length midpoint of a curved one.
SnapPoint.Edge is only meaningful for edge snap points; check SnapPoint.Type first (unverified what it returns otherwise).
Segment indices change when nodes are added or removed, so stored edge points can drift to another place.
cards.example:
Dim sp As SnapPoint
Set sp = ActiveShape.SnapPoints.Edge(1, 0.5)
Debug.Print sp.PositionX, sp.PositionY
Debug.Print sp.Edge.SegmentIndex, sp.Edge.SegmentOffset
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: Effect
cards.summary: Generic handle on one interactive effect applied to a shape (blend, contour, drop or inner shadow, extrude, envelope, lens, perspective, distortion, text on path, control path or custom effect). Type says which kind it is; the matching typed property gives its settings; Clear removes it and Separate breaks it into ordinary shapes.
use_for: walk every effect on a shape and adjust or remove one kind (e.g. soften all drop shadows)
bake a blend, contour or extrude into editable curves before sending to a cutter or another app
find which effects a template shape carries
avoid: creating effects: use the Shape.CreateDropShadow / CreateBlend / CreateContour / CreateExtrude / CreateEnvelope / CreateLens / CreatePerspective / Create...Distortion / CreateInnerShadow methods, which return an Effect
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffect. Obtained from the Shape.Create... methods, from Shape.Effects (Item, or typed accessors such as DropShadowEffect), or from Shape.Effect. Read Type (cdrEffectType) and then use only the matching property: Blend, Contour, DropShadow, InnerShadow, Extrude, Envelope, Lens, Perspective, Distortion, TextOnPath, ControlPath or Custom.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrEffectType: cdrBlend, cdrExtrude, cdrEnvelope, cdrTextOnPath, cdrControlPath, cdrDropShadow, cdrContour, cdrDistortion, cdrPerspective, cdrLens, cdrCustomEffect, cdrInnerShadow

key_members.name: ControlPath
key_members.use: effects that use this shape as their path (EffectControlPath)

key_members.name: Separate
key_members.use: break the effect into ordinary shapes; returns them as a ShapeRange

key_members.name: CloneParent
key_members.use: the effect this one was cloned from

gotchas: Only the property that matches Type is valid; reading another (e.g. .Blend on a drop shadow) is expected to raise an error (unverified exact behaviour).
The harvest describes Clear and Separate as 'blend' operations, but they sit on the generic Effect; whether Separate works for every type (e.g. lens, perspective) is unverified.
After Clear or Separate the Effect object is stale; do not reuse it.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
For Each e In ActiveShape.Effects
    If e.Type = cdrDropShadow Then e.DropShadow.Opacity = 35
Next e
Set e = ActiveShape.Effects.ContourEffect
If Not e Is Nothing Then e.Separate
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: example no longer calls Separate inside a For Each over the Effects it changes

cards.name: EffectBlend
cards.summary: Settings of a blend: the intermediate shapes CorelDRAW generates between a start and an end shape, with step count or spacing, rotation, colour direction, acceleration of spacing, colour and size, and an optional path to follow.
use_for: 3D-looking stacked or neon text from two outlines
smooth colour ramps and guilloche-style line art
rows of objects spaced evenly along a curved path (blend on path)
avoid: a single uniform outline around a shape: use a contour (EffectContour)
exact repeat counts with no morphing: Shape.StepAndRepeat
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectBlend. Create with startShape.CreateBlend(endShape, Steps, ColorBlendType, Mode, Spacing, Angle, Loop, Path, RotateShapes, SpacingAccel, ColorAccel, AccelSize) (defaults: 20 steps, direct colours); the call returns an Effect whose .Blend is this object. Existing blends: Shape.Effects.BlendEffects or Effect.Blend.

key_members.name: Spacing
key_members.use: distance between steps (cdrBlendSpacing, on a path)

key_members.name: Loop
key_members.use: rotate around a centre to make the blend loop

key_members.name: ColorBlendType
key_members.use: direct, rainbow clockwise or rainbow counter-clockwise colours

key_members.name: FullPath
key_members.use: stretch the blend over the whole path

key_members.name: RotateShapes
key_members.use: rotate steps to follow the path

key_members.name: ColorAcceleration
key_members.use: speed the colour change towards one end

key_members.name: Split
key_members.use: split the blend at a step into two blends

gotchas: Spacing only applies with Mode = cdrBlendSpacing and a path; on a straight blend Steps rules.
The steps live in BlendGroup and are regenerated on every change; edit the start / end shapes, or Separate the Effect, to get editable copies.
Blending shapes with different node counts can twist unexpectedly; set MapNodes with StartPoint / EndPoint to fix the correspondence.
CreateBlend's Steps parameter is typed int (default 20) while the Steps property is long.
cards.example:
Dim a As Shape, b As Shape, e As Effect
Set a = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(50, 150, 10)
Set b = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(150, 150, 30)
Set e = a.CreateBlend(b, 12)
e.Blend.ColorBlendType = cdrRainbowCWFountainFillBlend
e.Blend.Angle = 90
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectContour
cards.summary: Settings of a contour: a series of concentric outlines grown inside, outside or to the centre of a shape at a set offset and step count, with colour progression from the shape to a target outline / fill colour and control of end caps and corners.
use_for: sticker or die-cut outline around a logo or text (one outside step)
topographic or radiating-line art from a single shape
multi-ring retro type and badge outlines
avoid: morphing between two different shapes: use a blend (EffectBlend)
a single plain stroke: just set the outline width
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectContour. Create with Shape.CreateContour(Direction, Offset, Steps, BlendType, OutlineColor, FillColor, FillColor2, SpacingAccel, ColorAccel, EndCapType, CornerType, MiterLimit) (defaults: outside, 1 step, square caps, mitered offset bevel corners); it returns an Effect whose .Contour is this object. Existing contour: Shape.Effects.ContourEffect.Contour.

key_members.name: Offset
key_members.use: distance between steps, in document units

key_members.name: FillColor
key_members.use: fill colour of the last step

key_members.name: FillColorTo
key_members.use: second fill colour for fountain-filled shapes

key_members.name: OutlineColor
key_members.use: outline colour of the last step

key_members.name: SpacingAcceleration
key_members.use: change step spacing towards the end

key_members.name: ColorAcceleration
key_members.use: change colour progression towards the end

key_members.name: CornerType
key_members.use: cdrContourCorner... bevel, round or mitered variants

key_members.name: EndCapType
key_members.use: butt, round or square ends on open paths

gotchas: Offset follows Document.Unit, so the same macro gives different results in mm and inch documents unless Unit is set.
With cdrContourToCenter the step count follows from Offset and the shape size (unverified that Steps is ignored).
The contour steps are generated; for a cut line take the outermost step after Effect.Separate.
Inside contours on very thin or open shapes may produce nothing.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
ActiveDocument.Unit = cdrMillimeter
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateContour(cdrContourOutside, 2, 1)
e.Contour.CornerType = cdrContourCornerRound
e.Contour.FillColor.CMYKAssign 0, 0, 0, 0
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectControlPath
cards.summary: Effect object for a shape that is used as a path by other effects: it lists the blends and text-on-path effects attached to that path.
use_for: find every blend or text-on-path that depends on a guide curve before editing or deleting it
audit templates where text is fitted to a shared path
avoid: the blend or text settings themselves: go to the listed Effect's Blend or TextOnPath
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectControlPath. Reach it from the path shape: pathShape.Effects.ControlPathEffect.ControlPath (an Effect of Type cdrControlPath). Its Effects collection holds the attached Blend and TextOnPath effects.

key_members.name: Effects
key_members.use: the blend and text-on-path effects attached to this path

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the Effect (Type cdrControlPath) this belongs to

gotchas: Only blend and text-on-path effects are listed; envelopes or shadows referencing other shapes are not.
On a shape that is not used as a path, Effects.ControlPathEffect returns nothing useful (unverified: Nothing or an error).
Deleting the path shape detaches or removes the dependent effects (unverified which).
cards.example:
Dim cp As Effect, e As Effect
Set cp = ActiveShape.Effects.ControlPathEffect
If Not cp Is Nothing Then
    For Each e In cp.ControlPath.Effects
        Debug.Print e.Type
    Next e
End If
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectCustomDistortion
cards.summary: Properties of a custom distortion (Distortion type cdrDistortionCustom); the only harvested member is the identifier of the distortion. Which distortions in CorelDRAW 2024 are 'custom' (add-on or newer distortion types beyond Push-Pull, Zipper and Twister) is not shown by the harvest and is unverified.
use_for: read which custom distortion is applied to a shape before copying or removing it
avoid: Push-Pull, Zipper or Twister distortions: use EffectPushPullDistortion / EffectZipperDistortion / EffectTwisterDistortion
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectCustomDistortion. Reach it with Effect.Distortion.Custom when Effect.Distortion.Type = cdrDistortionCustom. Such distortions are created with Shape.CreateCustomDistortion(DistortionID, Parameters), whose IDs and parameter arrays are not documented in the type library.
gotchas: No settings beyond the ID are exposed, so a custom distortion cannot be tuned from VBA once applied; recreate it with new Parameters instead (unverified).
Valid DistortionID strings and their Parameters layout are not in the harvest; read the ID from an existing shape before trying to recreate one.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
For Each e In ActiveShape.Effects.DistortionEffects
    If e.Distortion.Type = cdrDistortionCustom Then Debug.Print e.Distortion.Custom.DistortionID
Next e
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectDistortion
cards.summary: Settings of a Distort-tool effect: the distortion type (Push-Pull, Zipper, Twister or custom), its centre point, and the type-specific sub-object holding amplitude, frequency or angle. The shape keeps its original curves, so the distortion stays editable.
use_for: starburst and flower shapes from a circle or polygon
jagged comic or electric edges on text and badges
swirled logos and decorative ornaments
avoid: regular perspective or envelope warps: use EffectPerspective or EffectEnvelope
cut-ready paths: Separate or convert to curves first, the distortion is live
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectDistortion. Created by Shape.CreatePushPullDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Amplitude), CreateZipperDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Amplitude, Frequency, Random, Smooth, Local) or CreateTwisterDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Angle); each returns an Effect whose .Distortion is this object. Existing ones: Shape.Effects.DistortionEffects.

key_members.name: CenterDistortion
key_members.use: move the centre to the middle of the shape

key_members.name: Zipper
key_members.use: Zipper settings (Amplitude, Frequency, Random, Smooth, Local)

gotchas: Only the sub-object matching Type is valid.
Distortions stack: Effects.DistortionEffects can hold several, applied in order.
OriginX / OriginY are taken as document coordinates (pass Shape.CenterX / CenterY for a centred effect; unverified that they are not shape-relative); off-centre origins change the look a lot.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
With ActiveShape
    Set e = .CreateZipperDistortion(.CenterX, .CenterY, 20, 8)
End With
e.Distortion.Zipper.Smooth = True
Debug.Print e.Distortion.Type
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: marked the coordinate-space claim for OriginX / OriginY as unverified

cards.name: EffectDropShadow
cards.summary: Settings of a drop shadow: a soft (feathered) bitmap shadow behind a shape, either flat with an X/Y offset or perspective (bottom, top, left, right) with angle, stretch and fade, plus opacity, colour, feather type and edge, and the merge (blend) mode.
use_for: lift product shots and cut-outs off a background on posters and social cards
soft text shadows for headlines over photos
perspective cast shadows that ground an object on a surface
avoid: vector-only output (cutting, embroidery, some print RIPs): the shadow is a bitmap, use a blended or offset vector copy
shading inside a shape: use an inner shadow (EffectInnerShadow)
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectDropShadow. Create with Shape.CreateDropShadow(Type, Opacity, Feather, OffsetX, OffsetY, Color, FeatherType, FeatherEdge, PerspectiveAngle, PerspectiveStretch, Fade, MergeMode) (defaults: flat, opacity 50, feather 15, Gaussian-blur feather type); it returns an Effect whose .DropShadow is this object. Existing shadow: Shape.Effects.DropShadowEffect.DropShadow.

key_members.name: FeatherEdge
key_members.use: cdrEdgeLinear / Squared / Flat / InverseSquared / Mesa / Gaussian

key_members.name: MergeMode
key_members.use: blend mode of the shadow (cdrMergeMultiply, cdrMergeNormal ...)

gotchas: The shadow is rendered as a bitmap at document resolution; PDF / EPS export rasterises it and low Document.Resolution makes it banded or soft.
OffsetX / OffsetY drive flat shadows; perspective types use PerspectiveAngle / PerspectiveStretch / Fade instead.
Offsets follow Document.Unit; set the unit before passing numbers.
MergeMode default is cdrMergeNormal (0) per the CreateDropShadow defaults; Multiply usually looks more natural over colour backgrounds.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
ActiveDocument.Unit = cdrMillimeter
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateDropShadow(cdrDropShadowFlat, 60, 12, 1.5, -1.5)
e.DropShadow.MergeMode = cdrMergeMultiply
e.DropShadow.Color.RGBAssign 20, 20, 40
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectEnvelope
cards.summary: Settings of an envelope: an editable container curve that warps a shape (including live text) to its outline, mapped in Putty, Original, Horizontal or Vertical mode (cdrEnvelopeMode), optionally keeping straight lines straight.
use_for: arch or bulge a headline into a banner, badge or pennant shape
fit a logo or pattern into a curved label area
warp artwork to the outline of another shape (CreateEnvelopeFromShape)
avoid: true 3D perspective: use EffectPerspective
fitting text along a line rather than filling a shape: use text on path (EffectTextOnPath)
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectEnvelope. Create with Shape.CreateEnvelope(PresetIndex, Mode, KeepLines), Shape.CreateEnvelopeFromShape(Source, Mode, KeepLines, CopyMode, CornerIndices) or Shape.CreateEnvelopeFromCurve(...); each returns an Effect whose .Envelope is this object. Existing envelope: Shape.Effects.EnvelopeEffects.

key_members.name: CopyFromShape
key_members.use: reshape the envelope from another shape (mode, keep lines, copy mode, corners)

key_members.name: CopyFromCurve
key_members.use: reshape the envelope from a curve

key_members.name: CreateFrom
key_members.use: make the envelope from a shape

key_members.name: Select
key_members.use: pick a preset envelope by index

key_members.name: CornerIndices
key_members.use: four node indices of the container that act as corners

gotchas: CreateEnvelope takes a preset index; valid indices depend on the installed envelope presets (unverified range).
CopyMode (cdrEnvelopeUseOriginal / Center / Stretch / Fit) decides how the source shape is mapped; the default from CreateEnvelopeFromShape is cdrEnvelopeCenter.
Strong envelopes on paragraph text can push text out of the frame; artistic text is safer.
Envelopes stack on top of other effects; order matters when combined with perspective or distortion.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect, target As Shape
Set target = ActiveSelectionRange(2)
Set e = ActiveSelectionRange(1).CreateEnvelopeFromShape(target, cdrEnvelopePutty, False, cdrEnvelopeFit)
e.Envelope.KeepLines = False

review.changes: summary called the Original mode 'Bezier' and Horizontal / Vertical 'straight-line'; they are mapping modes

cards.name: EffectExtrude
cards.summary: Settings of a vector extrusion: depth toward a vanishing point or parallel, 3D rotation, shading (object fill, solid, or colour shading between two colours), an optional bevel, and up to several lights. The result is a live group of vector faces.
use_for: chunky 3D headline and logo lettering for posters and thumbnails
isometric-looking icons and blocks
vector 3D type that stays editable and scalable for print
avoid: photo-real materials and lighting: the extrude is flat-shaded vector; render elsewhere
a simple offset shadow: use a drop shadow
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectExtrude. Create with Shape.CreateExtrude(Type, VPType, VPX, VPY, Depth, Shading, BaseColor, ShadingColor, BevelDepth, BevelAngle, BevelColor, BevelOnly) (Depth default 20, bevel angle 45); it returns an Effect whose .Extrude is this object. Existing extrusion: Shape.Effects.ExtrudeEffect.Extrude.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrExtrudeSmallBack / SmallFront / BigBack / BigFront / BackParallel / FrontParallel

key_members.name: Rotate
key_members.use: rotate the extrusion in 3D (AngleX, AngleY, AngleZ)

key_members.name: BaseColor
key_members.use: solid colour or start of the shading

key_members.name: SetBevel
key_members.use: set bevel depth, angle and bevel-only in one call

key_members.name: UseBevel
key_members.use: turn the bevel on or off

key_members.name: SetLight
key_members.use: place a light at an index with position and intensity

key_members.name: LightPresent
key_members.use: whether a light exists at an index

gotchas: Depth is a long in the property but a double in CreateExtrude; the UI caps depth (believed 1 to 99, unverified).
The faces in ExtrudeGroup are regenerated on every change; Separate the Effect for editable faces.
Light indices and how many lights are allowed are not in the harvest (unverified; the UI shows three).
Colour shading on fountain-filled control shapes can band in print; check at output size.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateExtrude(cdrExtrudeSmallBack, cdrVPLockedToShape, _
    ActiveShape.CenterX + 20, ActiveShape.CenterY - 30, 25, cdrExtrudeColorShading)
e.Extrude.BaseColor.RGBAssign 255, 120, 0
e.Extrude.ShadingColor.RGBAssign 90, 20, 0
e.Extrude.SetBevel 1, 45, False

cards.name: EffectInnerShadow
cards.summary: Settings of an inner shadow: a feathered bitmap shadow drawn inside a shape's edge, with offset or depth, opacity, colour, feather type and edge, and merge mode, giving a cut-in, pressed or engraved look.
use_for: pressed or engraved buttons and badges
letterpress and cut-out headline text
inset panels in UI mock-ups and infographics
avoid: shadows cast outside the shape: use a drop shadow (EffectDropShadow)
vector-only output: the inner shadow is a bitmap
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectInnerShadow. Create with Shape.CreateInnerShadow(Opacity, Feather, OffsetX, OffsetY, Color, FeatherType, FeatherEdge, MergeMode, Depth) (defaults: opacity 50, feather 15, offsets 0, Gaussian-blur feather, Depth -1); it returns an Effect whose .InnerShadow is this object. Existing one: Shape.Effects.InnerShadowEffect.InnerShadow.

key_members.name: Depth
key_members.use: shadow depth used when there is no offset

gotchas: Depth only matters for shadows without offsets; with offsets 0 and Depth -1 (the defaults) the look depends on the app's default depth (unverified).
Rendered as a bitmap at document resolution, like drop shadows; exports rasterise it.
Needs a closed, filled shape to show (unverified for open paths).
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
ActiveDocument.Unit = cdrMillimeter
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateInnerShadow(70, 10, 0.8, -0.8)
e.InnerShadow.MergeMode = cdrMergeMultiply
e.InnerShadow.Color.RGBAssign 0, 0, 0
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectLens
cards.summary: Settings of a lens: a shape that changes how everything beneath it looks inside its outline (magnify, fish-eye, wireframe, colour limit, colour add, invert, brighten, tinted greyscale, heat map, transparency or custom colour map), optionally from a fixed viewpoint and optionally frozen into real shapes.
use_for: magnifier call-outs on maps, infographics and product diagrams
invert or greyscale a region of a layout through a shape
heat-map or colour-limit looks over vector art without editing it
avoid: plain see-through: the Transparency tool is the modern route; the transparency lens is legacy
files for other apps: lenses do not survive export as live effects, Freeze them first
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectLens. Create with Shape.CreateLens(Type, RateOrMagnification, Color1, Color2, ColorMapPalette) (rate default 50); it returns an Effect whose .Lens is this object. Existing lens: Shape.Effects.LensEffect.Lens.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrLensMagnify / FishEye / Wireframe / ColorLimit / ColorAdd / Invert / Brighten / TintedGrayscale / HeatMap / Transparency / CustomColorMap

key_members.name: Magnification
key_members.use: magnification amount for the magnify lens

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: lens colour (colour limit, colour add, tinted greyscale)

key_members.name: FromColor
key_members.use: start colour of a custom colour map

key_members.name: ToColor
key_members.use: end colour of a custom colour map

key_members.name: ColorMapPalette
key_members.use: direct or rainbow mapping for custom colour maps

key_members.name: OutlineColor
key_members.use: outline colour for the wireframe lens

key_members.name: FillColor
key_members.use: fill colour for the wireframe lens

key_members.name: UseViewPoint
key_members.use: look through from a separate viewpoint

key_members.name: RemoveFace
key_members.use: show the lens only where it covers other objects

key_members.name: Freeze
key_members.use: turn the current view into real shapes

key_members.name: Unfreeze
key_members.use: make a frozen lens live again

key_members.name: Shapes
key_members.use: shapes of a frozen lens group

gotchas: CreateLens has one RateOrMagnification argument: it means Magnification for the magnify lens and Rate for the others (unverified for fish-eye).
A live lens recomputes from what lies beneath; moving the lens or the art changes the result. Freeze before handing files off.
Lens effects on bitmaps may render only on screen and rasterise or drop on export to PDF / EPS (unverified for 25.1).
Wireframe uses OutlineColor / FillColor with UseOutlineColor / UseFillColor, not Color.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateLens(cdrLensMagnify, 2)
e.Lens.UseViewPoint = True
e.Lens.ViewPointX = ActiveShape.CenterX + 40
e.Lens.ViewPointY = ActiveShape.CenterY

cards.name: EffectPerspective
cards.summary: Settings of a perspective effect: one-point or two-point perspective on a shape or group, set by the positions of a horizontal and / or vertical vanishing point.
use_for: put flat artwork onto a wall, sign or box side in a mock-up
receding title text for retro posters
simple packaging and signage previews
avoid: curved warps: use an envelope (EffectEnvelope)
3D depth with sides: use an extrusion (EffectExtrude)
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectPerspective. Create with Shape.CreatePerspective(HorizVanishPointX, HorizVanishPointY, VertVanishPointX, VertVanishPointY) (Variant arguments, so a pair can be left out for one-point perspective); it returns an Effect whose .Perspective is this object. Existing ones: Shape.Effects.PerspectiveEffects.

key_members.name: HorizVanishingPointX
key_members.use: x of the horizontal vanishing point

key_members.name: HorizVanishingPointY
key_members.use: y of the horizontal vanishing point

key_members.name: VertVanishingPointX
key_members.use: x of the vertical vanishing point

key_members.name: VertVanishingPointY
key_members.use: y of the vertical vanishing point

gotchas: Vanishing points are in document coordinates and are often far off the page; small distances give extreme distortion.
One-point versus two-point is set by the Use... flags, not by a separate type.
Perspective is a live envelope-like effect; text stays editable underneath, but exporting to other apps flattens it to curves (unverified for all formats).
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
With ActiveShape
    Set e = .CreatePerspective(.CenterX + 300, .CenterY)
End With
e.Perspective.UseVertVanishingPoint = False
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectPushPullDistortion
cards.summary: Settings of a Push-Pull distortion: a single amplitude that moves a shape's nodes away from or toward the distortion centre, turning circles and polygons into spiky stars or rounded flower petals.
use_for: starburst price badges and sale stickers
flower and petal ornaments from a polygon
playful bulging logo shapes
avoid: regular stars with exact points: draw them with the Star / Polygon tool (Layer.CreatePolygon2)
zig-zag edges: use the Zipper distortion
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectPushPullDistortion. Create with Shape.CreatePushPullDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Amplitude); the returned Effect's .Distortion.PushPull is this object.

key_members.name: Amplitude
key_members.use: strength and direction of the push or pull (long)

gotchas: The sign of Amplitude chooses push versus pull; which sign gives the spiky (pucker) look and which the rounded (bloat) look is unverified, so test both.
Amplitude range is not in the harvest (the UI is believed to allow -200 to 200, unverified).
The look depends on node count: add nodes (or use a polygon with more sides) for more points.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
With ActiveShape
    Set e = .CreatePushPullDistortion(.CenterX, .CenterY, -60)
End With
Debug.Print e.Distortion.PushPull.Amplitude
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: Effects
cards.summary: Collection of all effects applied to one shape, with typed shortcuts to each single-instance effect (contour, drop shadow, inner shadow, extrude, lens, text on path, control path) and sub-collections for the stackable kinds (blends, distortions, envelopes, perspectives, custom).
use_for: check whether a shape already has a shadow or contour before adding one
strip or restyle every effect on imported artwork
audit effects before exporting to a format that cannot keep them
avoid: removing one kind of effect: Shape.ClearEffect(cdrEffectType) does it in one call (Shape.FlattenEffects is different: it converts the shape with live bitmap effects into a bitmap)
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffects. Reach it with Shape.Effects. Item is base 1; the ...Effect properties return one Effect (or nothing) and the ...Effects properties return Effects sub-collections.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of effects on the shape

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the effects

key_members.name: ControlPathEffect
key_members.use: blends and text-on-path effects that use this shape as path

gotchas: Effects of a group or effect-group shape (cdrDropShadowGroupShape, cdrContourGroupShape, cdrBlendGroupShape ...) may be reached from the group or from the control shape; which one holds them depends on the effect (unverified).
The single-instance properties are expected to return Nothing when the effect is absent (unverified: may raise an error instead); test both in a robust macro.
Item is base 1.
cards.example:
Dim fx As Effects
Set fx = ActiveShape.Effects
Debug.Print fx.Count
If fx.DropShadowEffect Is Nothing Then
    ActiveShape.CreateDropShadow cdrDropShadowFlat, 50, 15, 1, -1
End If
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: avoid suggested FlattenEffects for removing effects; it rasterises the shape

cards.name: EffectTextOnPath
cards.summary: Settings of text fitted to a path: which text and path, distance from the path, offset along it, letter orientation (rotate, skew, upright), horizontal and vertical placement, which side of the path, and the starting quadrant on closed paths.
use_for: circular badge, seal and stamp lettering
text running along a wave, river or road in illustrations
curved labels on logos and packaging
avoid: warping text into a shape: use an envelope
long body copy: text on a path is for short lines

equivalents.AI: Type/Type on a Path/Type on a Path Options...

cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectTextOnPath. Create by fitting text: textShape.Text.FitToPath(pathShape) returns an Effect whose .TextOnPath is this object. Existing one: Shape.Effects.TextOnPathEffect.TextOnPath; the path's Effects.ControlPathEffect lists it too.

key_members.name: VertPlacement
key_members.use: baseline, ascender, descender, centre or custom

key_members.name: PlaceOnOtherSide
key_members.use: put the text on the other side of the path

key_members.name: Quadrant
key_members.use: start quadrant on a closed path: left, right, top, bottom

gotchas: Offset and DistanceFromPath follow Document.Unit.
Quadrant only makes sense on closed paths such as ellipses (unverified on open paths).
Deleting the path removes or detaches the fitting (unverified which); hide the path by setting no outline instead.
For bottom-of-circle text that reads upright, combine PlaceOnOtherSide with a second text object; one text cannot run both ways.
cards.example:
Dim t As Shape, c As Shape, e As Effect
Set c = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(100, 100, 40)
Set t = ActiveLayer.CreateArtisticText(0, 0, "CERTIFIED ORGANIC")
Set e = t.Text.FitToPath(c)
e.TextOnPath.Quadrant = cdrTopQuadrant
e.TextOnPath.DistanceFromPath = 2
