cards.name: EffectTwisterDistortion
cards.summary: Settings of a Twister distortion: one rotation angle that swirls a shape around the distortion centre, more at the outside than at the centre, giving a twisted spiral look.
use_for: swirled ornaments and spiral logos
psychedelic or hypnotic poster shapes
twisted star and flower motifs
avoid: plain rotation: use Shape.Rotate
spirals drawn from scratch: the Spiral tool (Layer.CreateSpiral)
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectTwisterDistortion. Create with Shape.CreateTwisterDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Angle); the returned Effect's .Distortion.Twister is this object.
gotchas: Angles above 360 add extra turns (unverified upper limit).
Shapes with few nodes twist coarsely; add nodes first for a smooth swirl.
The twist is centred on OriginX / OriginY of the parent distortion, not on the shape unless you pass its centre.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
With ActiveShape
    Set e = .CreateTwisterDistortion(.CenterX, .CenterY, 180)
End With
e.Distortion.Twister.Angle = 270
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EffectZipperDistortion
cards.summary: Settings of a Zipper distortion: zig-zag ridges along a shape's edges, with amplitude, frequency, and switches for random size, smooth (wavy) ridges and local falloff toward the centre.
use_for: torn, jagged or electric edges on comic panels and stickers
wavy scalloped borders when Smooth is on
rough grunge type and badges
avoid: regular sine-like borders with exact count along a path: a pattern brush or Artistic Media stroke may be easier
cards.how: Members live on IVGEffectZipperDistortion. Create with Shape.CreateZipperDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Amplitude, Frequency, Random, Smooth, Local); the returned Effect's .Distortion.Zipper is this object.

key_members.name: Smooth
key_members.use: rounded waves instead of sharp points

key_members.name: Local
key_members.use: strongest at the origin, fading outward

gotchas: Amplitude and Frequency ranges are not in the harvest (UI believed 0 to 100, unverified).
Frequency is per segment, so a shape with more nodes gets more ridges.
Random re-rolls when the distortion is recomputed (unverified), so the jag pattern may change on edit.
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
With ActiveShape
    Set e = .CreateZipperDistortion(.CenterX, .CenterY, 15, 10)
End With
e.Distortion.Zipper.Random = True
e.Distortion.Zipper.Smooth = False
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: Ellipse
cards.summary: Properties of an ellipse shape: whether it is a full ellipse, an arc or a pie, its start and end angles and direction, its centre and its horizontal and vertical radii. The shape stays an editable ellipse until converted to curves.
use_for: pie and donut-chart segments in infographics
circular badges and seals sized exactly from the centre
arcs for gauges and progress rings
avoid: free node editing: convert to curves first (Shape.ConvertToCurves), which ends the ellipse object
cards.how: Members live on IVGEllipse. Create with ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse(Left, Top, Right, Bottom, StartAngle, EndAngle, Pie), CreateEllipse2(CenterX, CenterY, Radius1, Radius2, StartAngle, EndAngle, Pie) or CreateEllipseRect; read or edit an existing one with Shape.Ellipse when Shape.Type = cdrEllipseShape.

key_members.name: Clockwise
key_members.use: direction of the arc or pie

key_members.name: SetRadius
key_members.use: set horizontal and optional vertical radius

gotchas: CreateEllipse / CreateEllipse2 default StartAngle and EndAngle to 90; equal angles give a full ellipse, so pass different angles plus Pie = True for a wedge.
Radii and centre follow Document.Unit.
On a rotated or skewed ellipse the radii are in the ellipse's own frame, not the page (unverified).
Shape.Ellipse is only valid when Shape.Type = cdrEllipseShape.
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
ActiveDocument.Unit = cdrMillimeter
Set s = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(100, 100, 40)
s.Ellipse.Type = cdrPie
s.Ellipse.StartAngle = 0
s.Ellipse.EndAngle = 270
cards.source: cdr_api_06 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: EPS
cards.summary: A placed (encapsulated) EPS object: CorelDRAW shows its preview bitmap and passes the PostScript through on output. Gives the preview, the raw EPS data, the crop envelope (clipping path), the original bounding box, the linked file name and DCS separation file names.
use_for: check which linked EPS files a legacy print job depends on
pull the raw EPS stream out of a document for archiving
reset an EPS that was cropped by mistake
avoid: editing the artwork: import the EPS as editable objects (interpreted) instead of placing it
PDF / screen workflows that cannot pass PostScript through: convert to vectors or PDF first
cards.how: Members live on IVGEPS. Reach it with Shape.EPS when Shape.Type = cdrEPSShape. Placed EPS shapes come from importing an EPS as a placeable file (Layer.Import / ImportEx with the right import options, unverified option name).

key_members.name: LinkFileName
key_members.use: path of the linked EPS file

key_members.name: Data
key_members.use: the EPS stream as a byte array

key_members.name: DataAsString
key_members.use: the EPS stream as a string

key_members.name: CropEnvelope
key_members.use: curve of the current clipping path

key_members.name: CropEnvelopeModified
key_members.use: True when the clipping path was changed

key_members.name: BoundingBoxPath
key_members.use: curve of the original bounding box

key_members.name: DCSFileNames
key_members.use: file names of DCS separation plates

gotchas: What prints is the PostScript, what shows is only the preview; a low-resolution or missing preview hides problems.
Output to non-PostScript devices or PDF may use the preview or need interpretation (unverified for 25.1 PDF export).
Shape.EPS is only valid when Shape.Type = cdrEPSShape.
DataAsString on binary EPS (with TIFF preview) can be mangled; use Data for a byte-exact copy.
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActivePage.Shapes
    If s.Type = cdrEPSShape Then
        Debug.Print s.Name, s.EPS.LinkFileName, s.EPS.CropEnvelopeModified
    End If
Next s
